zusammenfassung: This week shows a clear trend: on-device AI and EU-based tools are gaining ground. Proofly shows that professional AI features are possible without the cloud, while Nume, an EU start-up, stands out with GDPR compliance. At the same time, several innovative US tools (Bloom, Exa, Notis) show gaps in data protection.
highlights: Stars of the week: Proofly and Nume (9/10)
Trend: on-device AI and EU tools
Caution: US tools with data protection gaps
